title: Dearlys Grocery Store AH154 International Resourcing Services 1998 Resin Village
conditionDescription: Light wear, small chips/rubs along the base edges and roofline - see close-ups. No box.
descriptionText:
"Dearly's Grocery Store" (AH154) - International Resourcing Services, Inc., 1998. Miniature resin brick general store with the ESTABLISHED 1875 sign, striped awnings, produce stand on the side ("Mueller's Extract - Good for Man or Beast" and "Have You Tried Pearl Soap?" painted signs), exterior staircase, barrels and crates on the porch, and a sandy landscaped base. Green felt underside with the original gold foil label. About 3.5 inches tall.

No box - figurine only.

Condition: Pre-owned. Light wear with small paint chips/rubs, mostly along the base edges and roofline (see close-up photos). Please review all photos - they are of the actual piece you will receive.
